bear_case.title: Valuation re-rating debate
bear_case.description: Early-stage defense startups fetch 17x-50x revenue; Anduril, Shield AI and Saronic have each roughly doubled valuation within a year. AVAV and KTOS are both down 40%+ YTD despite record backlogs — public markets are already repricing.

bear_case.title: Budget politics
bear_case.description: FY27 requests aren't appropriations; NATO summit in Turkey and US pressure on allies over spending commitments add near-term political risk to the rearmament timeline.

bear_case.title: Legacy vs new-tech split
bear_case.description: If money flows to legacy platforms over AI/drones/EW, software-first names underperform expectations.

bear_case.title: Program concentration
bear_case.description: Pure-plays often depend on a handful of contracts; a single loss (e.g., CCA downselect) can reprice a stock sharply.
